h1: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Pune

h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Pune

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Pune

c: Pune walks uphill. Every morning, groups climb Parvati, Taljai and Vetal Tekdi, and the city's gardens and riverside paths fill with walkers and runners. FunPlay Systems is an outdoor gym equipment supplier in Pune for housing societies, IT and corporate campuses, schools, colleges and the gardens of the Pune Municipal Corporation. Our Vasai factory is about 140 km away, so equipment reaches Pune by road with little fuss.

Our installation team or a dealer fixes the machines at your site. Pune's weather is kind to an outdoor gym. Summers are warm, the monsoon from June to September is steady and winters are cool and dry. Buyers here tend to ask detailed questions about each machine and who will use it. We answer with a layout drawing that marks every station and its clear space before anything is made.

richText.heading: A corporate campus or society gym in Pune

c: Campus staff in Pune usually want a quick workout before or after work, close to the parking or cafeteria. The
Fun Rower
gives a full-body session in a few minutes. The
ABB Trainer
works the core, which desk workers often neglect. The
Shoulder Twirl Double
loosens tight shoulders for two people at once.

Housing societies can use the same three near the walking track, and add gentler stations for senior members later. Keep the gym on paving or rubber flooring rather than lawn, so it stays usable through the monsoon. For children's equipment, see our
playground equipment in Pune

facts.label: Distance
facts.value: About 140 km from our Vasai factory (straight line)

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: Can an IT campus in Pune order an outdoor gym for employees?
items.a: Yes. Send the space available, photos and the number of employees likely to use it. We suggest machines and send a layout drawing and quote for your facilities team.

items.q: Can the gym be placed on a hill slope or uneven ground?
items.a: Each machine needs a level footing. On a slope, a small levelled pad for each machine works. Share photos and rough levels, and we plan positions on the layout.

items.q: Do you offer custom colours for a society gym?
items.a: Our roto-moulded parts come in more than 15 colour shades, and design customisation is available on request. Mention your preferred colours when you ask for a quote.
